root_cause: The 1918 code did call showPlanLoading() when Zoek mijn roadtrip was pressed, but #planLoadingOverlay was physically nested inside #itineraryView. ReisSlim CSS hides every inactive .app-view with display:none. While the user is on plannerView, itineraryView is inactive, so its child overlay cannot render even when the overlay's own hidden class is removed.
correction: Moved #planLoadingOverlay out of itineraryView and made it a body-level global overlay. The same overlay can now be shown from Planner, itinerary calculation, routing, POI, accommodation, and other pending stages. Existing fixed-position overlay CSS and 1-second image rotation are retained.
